name: Beef Flank Steak
siboNotes: Plain beef is SIBO-friendly as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates. Choose lean cuts and avoid marinades with garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Marinate with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, and oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Slice against the grain after cooking for tenderness
Grill, broil, or pan-sear at high heat for best results
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
